newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona June air cargo traffic up 1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona June air cargo traffic up 1 percent.

text.p: Just over 6,534 tonnes of cargo traffic passed through Spain's Barcelona airport in June, 1.0 percent mor than the same month last year, the airport authority said.
The accumulated cargo volume so far this year now stands at 41,637 tonnes, 10.8 percent more than the first six months of 1996.

Non-European Union international freight was still the fastest growing area with a 13.8 percent increase in June to 974 tonnes. The volume of domestic cargo rose 2.0 percent to 2,676 tonnes, after falling in May. European Union cargo, which showed double digit growth in the previous three months, fell 0.2 percent to 2,984 tonnes.

Passenger numbers, excluding transit passengers, rose 14.3 percent to 1.31 million in the month, taking the year to date total to 6.92 million, up 14.0 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
